question.question: Does sharpness-aware minimization (rho 0.05) on the unchanged post-BN K1 improve fixed-100K development Gap MAE?
question.deficiency: Online train MAE (0.098 eV) is far below development MAE (0.141 eV) and input, capacity and activation regularisers at 100K were negative or below gate; no weight-space sharpness method has been run on K1.
alternatives: No effect on the generalisation gap
Double gradient work does not change the endpoint
question.positive_decision: Nominate only for independently authorized replication or transfer after complete paired acceptance
question.negative_decision: Close without adoption, retry, rho sweep or scale-up
